title: The promenade round the major set is the progression
assumes: The neighbour promenade counterclockwise round the major set is the travel: it walks you the whole way to number two's place and lets go there, so the cast back is already a figure of the new seating rather than the last step of the old one.
quotes: A1  (8) Ladies chain to neighbor  (8) Neighbor promenade counterclockwise around the major set
notes: The record's own clause on A2's cast-back is removed, so this reading has exactly one: the promenade carries it, at the promenade's end. The two are a hair apart in beats — the cast back begins where the promenade stops — and what differs is which call is danced in which seating and whether the dancers the call leaves out slide with their line.
